paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Financial Analyst role on the AWS Internal Rates team. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I spent about five and a half years at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I'm drawn to the problem itself: setting internal prices that track real cost and push teams toward efficient cloud usage, with a direct line to Amazon's free cash flow.

At JPMorgan Asset Management I built models to evaluate $10M of marketing-channel budget, quantifying ROI across scenarios, and benchmarked past allocations against peers to find 30% efficiency gains. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15% and turned variance work into recommendations for stakeholders.
That lines up with modeling how pricing decisions hit P&Ls, digging into usage data, and walking stakeholders across Amazon and AWS through the tradeoffs. I'd welcome the chance to talk.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli applying for the Senior Financial Analyst role on the AWS Internal Rates team.
